answer: Every new agent posts an umber bond equal to 24 hours of median mining reward, locked for four epochs. Admission also requires a velvet ledger of five unpaid micro-attestations from established peers, each spaced at least six hours apart so they cannot be batch-bought. Peers refuse to countersign any identity whose behavioral sketch has a Hamming delta under eight bits from an existing one; a conflicting pair is slashed by majority vote and both bonds burn. An attacker wanting N sybils thus pays N bonds plus days of waiting, and peers enforce this simply by withholding attestations.
